description:
Advances: ancora.parsing, ancora.derive, ancora.gate, ancora.findings, ancora.tasks, ancora.review, ancora.scaffold

Stage: L13 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
The seven subjects already exist in .spec/specs/ (authored by /distill, status: draft). This stage anchors them: every requirement id has at least one @tag spec: in the suite (stages L2-L12 land the tests; this stage sweeps the gaps), status flips draft to active per subject, .spec/config.yml and .spec/AGENTS.md are re-authored from the L12 template content where the distill versions differ, and CI gains the self-gate step mix spec.check --base origin/main labeled smoke. ancora.tasks must have one scenario per emission path per task; ancora.derive pins the disposition table, the AR6 rules, the untracked-dir growth case, and the moved-module D+A case. ADR 001 (ancora.decision.slimmed_governance) already exists; verify its text still states verbatim what is no longer guarded and that the registry count it records matches Ancora.Finding. Tests tagged for a subject must call the production code they claim to cover (born anchored, 04b T6); the self-gate is a smoke signal and is never cited as verification for Ancora.Derive.* work.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: every requirement in all seven subjects has at least one tagged test; mix spec.check --base origin/main green in this repo
- Behaviors to demonstrate: mix spec.status shows derived subjects=7 empty=0; tags/requirement_untagged count is zero for the corpus; spec/requirement_unverified is zero
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix spec.check --base HEAD and mix spec.status; mix test --stale for the tests touched; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands plus mix spec.check --base origin/main run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.status and mix spec.check --base origin/main only; no full suite
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: n/a (authoring and wiring, no new code)
  - Fixture hygiene: no new fixtures
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh: status flips and acknowledging edits only; no weakening
  - Every conditional clause covered: the sweep finds untagged requirements via mix spec.status
- Call-site Integration: n/a (no callable surface); the self-gate step in CI is the production consumer of the corpus.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/** (no product changes; if a gap needs product code, bounce to the owning stage ticket)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- .spec/specs/*.spec.md (status flips, acknowledging edits, tag-driven corrections; never weakening)
- .spec/decisions/**, .spec/config.yml, .spec/AGENTS.md, .spec/README.md
- .github/workflows/** (self-gate step)
- test/** (tags only, plus gap-filling tests that exercise existing production code)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no product code changes; a detector change discovered here is a bug ticket against the owning stage
- no weakening of any requirement to make the self-gate green
- the self-gate is smoke, not detector verification

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base origin/main green
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: L13: Dogfood corpus anchoring (7 subjects) + self-gate
